title: PMW3901+VL53L1X Optical Flow: Battle-Tested for Indoor Position Hold
context: Project Avatar Splash water gun drone needs indoor position hold for Senior Assassins (hallways, gyms). The current $312 BOM has GPS-only positioning.
what_was_found: The esp-drone repository (1852 stars) contains complete production-tested PMW3901+VL53L1X optical flow implementation. Key parameters: adaptive noise stdFlow = 0.0007984 * shutter + 0.4335, outlier rejection at 100 pixels, 100-200Hz update rate. ArduPilot integration is configuration-only: EK2_GPS_TYPE=3, FLOW_TYPE=1, FLOW_ENABLE=1, EK2_FLOW_M_NSE=0.15, RNGFND1_TYPE=36.
action: Add PMW3901+VL53L1X to BOM ($15, 3g). Connect to ArduPilot SPI/I2C bus. Configure EKF2 parameters.
